_about: Rules for app/matching: how a claimed amount, date or PIN is found in a page's OCR text. Every value was chosen by the measured trial in tools/search_criteria_trial (2026-09-23: 15,673 cases, 65 real pages, zero false matches) and approved by the user; change one only with a re-run of that trial. Values are always compared exactly after these normalisations -- never fuzzy.
_currency_words: Currency words that may be attached to or stand beside an amount ('Ksh200.00', '5,000 Birr'). Also the context that lets an amount printed without cents count.
_no_cents_endings: East African 'no cents' endings ('200/='); count as a currency marker.
_tax_code_letters: One letter a fiscal printer puts right after an amount ('1,060.00B'); trimmed.
_amount_prefix_marks: Characters before an amount that belong to the printer, not the value. ERCA receipts (Ethiopia) print '*1.130.45'; OCR reads that asterisk as '*', 'x', '×', '≠' or '±' (seen on the July receipts, page 21).
_total_labels: Labels after which an amount printed without cents counts when nothing else follows it on the line ('TOTAL 1,200').
_thousands_separators: Printed thousands separators generated for every claimed amount ('' = none).
_one_decimal_forms: Also search '6175.0' for 6175.00 (bank app screenshots, telebirr '0.0 Birr').
_tail_join_gap_per_height: A value OCR split into two segments is joined only when the right part is a decimal tail ('.00', or '1,200.' + '00') and the gap is at most this many text heights. General joining was measured to glue quantities onto prices.
_dates: Day-first dates in every zero-padding, 2/4-digit year and separator variant, year-first ISO, and month-name forms from month_names.
_pin_formats: L = letter, D = digit. Only used to undo OCR letter/digit confusions in positions where the format allows just one kind. KRA PIN and a 10-digit TIN.
_lookalike_pairs: One differing PIN character is accepted only for these OCR look-alike pairs (user decision). Any-one-character was measured to give 240 false matches.
_pin_labels: Label words OCR may fuse directly onto a PIN with no space or colon ('PinA012345678Z' on an Uchumi receipt). Only these words may be glued in front of a PIN; compared without spaces, any case.
_neighbours_each_side: Segments on the same printed row, each side of a match, also outlined (lightly) so the label next to a value is visible.
